data.body: Gerrit 3053 PS1: LLM-Review -1, 2 blocking findings (same defect): the parametrized rule builds its cases from discovery at collection time, so an empty discovery would collect zero cases and pass vacuously. Fixed in PS2 (dcbbe120f780): new non-parametrized floor test test_verified_lane_reusable_discovery_finds_the_gating_reusables asserts build-and-test, mutation, optionality and scanner-integration are discovered (red proof: pointing mutation's uses at a non-_ path fails it). Advisory also fixed: push/PR callers are found by parsed jobs[*].uses, not a text match (red proof: a lane mentioning the reusable only in a comment fails). Advisory left: reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md:270 names the deleted _SHARED_GATE_SIGNATURES/_DOCUMENTATION_GATE_SIGNATURES (reports/ is outside this story's file impact). Corrected counts: AFTER 42 nodes (35 + 7) from 30 + 7 functions; BEFORE unchanged at 49. make verify ran on PS1 (17 failed / 19700 passed, all pandoc); PS2 reran make lint + both modules (42 passed).
